hand-wraps-constrictor.name: ★ Hand Wraps | Constrictor
hand-wraps-constrictor.desc: Preferred by hand-to-hand fighters, these wraps protect the knuckles and stabilize the wrist when punching.

moto-gloves-transport.name: ★ Moto Gloves | Transport
moto-gloves-transport.desc: These bulky hard knuckled gloves can protect the wearers hands from road rash at 60 mph. This pair has a subtle digital camo.

driver-gloves-wave-chaser.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Wave Chaser
driver-gloves-wave-chaser.desc: These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation.

sport-gloves-pandoras-box.name: ★ Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box
sport-gloves-pandoras-box.desc:
Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching. The black and purple gloves have a subtle pattern printed on the palms.

A must have for any demolitions expert with sweaty palms

hydra-gloves-rattler.name: ★ Hydra Gloves | Rattler
hydra-gloves-rattler.desc: These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Hydra logo. It was crafted from a mix of leather, snakeskin, and brass.

ak-47-x-ray.name: AK-47 | X-Ray
ak-47-x-ray.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. A custom painted AK-47 showing its internals with an X-Ray.

When all is revealed you may not like what you see...

aug-steel-sentinel.name: AUG | Steel Sentinel
aug-steel-sentinel.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been custom painted in gunmetal grey.

Solid steel and cold as death

aug-fleet-flock.name: AUG | Fleet Flock
aug-fleet-flock.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been given a hydrographic of birds flying through clouds.

Some birds represent harmony and peace... these are not those birds

aug-colony.name: AUG | Colony
aug-colony.desc: Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has individual parts spray-painted khaki and grey.

awp-the-prince.name: AWP | The Prince
awp-the-prince.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted with a red base and gold filigree.

Peace be with thee

pp-bizon-modern-hunter.name: PP-Bizon | Modern Hunter
pp-bizon-modern-hunter.desc: The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been painted using a photographic hunting camo hydrographic.

pp-bizon-sand-dashed.name: PP-Bizon | Sand Dashed
pp-bizon-sand-dashed.desc: The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been spray-painted using short pieces of tape as stencils.

dual-berettas-silver-pour.name: Dual Berettas | Silver Pour
dual-berettas-silver-pour.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. A grayscale acrylic pour pattern has been applied.

In the end it all seems to come together

five-seven-desert-seal.name: Five-SeveN | Desert Seal
five-seven-desert-seal.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been custom painted with a Desert Seal design in silver and purple.

Fate calls

g3sg1-chronos.name: G3SG1 | Chronos
g3sg1-chronos.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been decorated with a hydrographic of watch mechanisms in psychedelic colors and accented with heat transfer decals.

In time, all things are possible

g3sg1-hunter.name: G3SG1 | Hunter
g3sg1-hunter.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. The gun's black base has been covered with dark wood paneling.

It smells of rich mahogany

g3sg1-digital-mesh.name: G3SG1 | Digital Mesh
g3sg1-digital-mesh.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been painted with a custom red, white, and charcoal-colored DDPAT pattern.

Disruptingly intricate

g3sg1-ventilator.name: G3SG1 | Ventilator
g3sg1-ventilator.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been given an elegant black and chrome paintjob and a custom rubber stock.

Don't worry Naomi, I'll make Felix pay - Mikha Biton, Phoenix Sniper

glock-18-gamma-doppler-phase-2.name: Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler
glock-18-gamma-doppler-phase-2.desc: The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

glock-18-block-18.name: Glock-18 | Block-18
glock-18-block-18.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been custom painted to section the weapon off into colored blocks.

Blocked and loaded

p2000-obsidian.name: P2000 | Obsidian
p2000-obsidian.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been custom painted to look like it was submerged in lava and is solidifying into obsidian as it cools.

Giving the term "glass cannon" a whole new meaning

p2000-red-wing.name: P2000 | Red Wing
p2000-red-wing.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been custom painted with a charcoal and deep red-colored design. 

Preying on your enemies' downfall

flip-knife-night.name: ★ Flip Knife | Night
flip-knife-night.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a night ops color scheme.

It's the whisper of the wind... it's the bite at your neck

gut-knife-doppler-black-pearl.name: ★ Gut Knife | Doppler
gut-knife-doppler-black-pearl.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

navaja-knife-fade.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Fade
navaja-knife-fade.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

navaja-knife-tiger-tooth.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Tiger Tooth
navaja-knife-tiger-tooth.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...

navaja-knife-blue-steel.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Blue Steel
navaja-knife-blue-steel.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been cold blued.

This is the malbec of weapon design - Booth, Arms Dealer

navaja-knife-stained.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Stained
navaja-knife-stained.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

karambit-rust-coat.name: ★ Karambit | Rust Coat
karambit-rust-coat.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. This memento from Siege is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Scars build character

m9-bayonet-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Doppler
m9-bayonet-doppler-phase-3.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

m9-bayonet-marble-fade.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Marble Fade
m9-bayonet-marble-fade.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

nomad-knife-fade.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Fade
nomad-knife-fade.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

nomad-knife-tiger-tooth.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Tiger Tooth
nomad-knife-tiger-tooth.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...

nomad-knife-blue-steel.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Blue Steel
nomad-knife-blue-steel.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been cold blued.

This is the malbec of weapon design - Booth, Arms Dealer

nomad-knife-stained.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Stained
nomad-knife-stained.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

skeleton-knife-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Doppler
skeleton-knife-doppler-phase-3.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

skeleton-knife-marble-fade.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Marble Fade
skeleton-knife-marble-fade.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

bowie-knife-ultraviolet.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Ultraviolet
bowie-knife-ultraviolet.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent

huntsman-knife-boreal-forest.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Boreal Forest
huntsman-knife-boreal-forest.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

ursus-knife-doppler-black-pearl.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Doppler
ursus-knife-doppler-black-pearl.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

talon-knife-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Talon Knife | Doppler
talon-knife-doppler-phase-4.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

m4a4-in-living-color.name: M4A4 | In Living Color
m4a4-in-living-color.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted using neon colors and covered with hand-drawn designs.

Fight for one, fight for all

m4a4-hellish.name: M4A4 | Hellish
m4a4-hellish.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted with orange and yellow flames over a black glitter base.

Like hell...

m4a1-s-fizzy-pop.name: M4A1-S | Fizzy POP
m4a1-s-fizzy-pop.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. A tan and red retro techno-inspired pattern has been applied.

Wars are won with information

mac-10-amber-fade.name: MAC-10 | Amber Fade
mac-10-amber-fade.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

mac-10-classic-crate.name: MAC-10 | Classic Crate
mac-10-classic-crate.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been hand painted to resemble the green metal crates originally found on de_dust2.

Rush B, don't stop

mag-7-bi83-spectrum.name: MAG-7 | BI83 Spectrum
mag-7-bi83-spectrum.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been custom painted to resemble iridescent bismuth crystals.

Why are the rarest things the most beautiful?

mag-7-seabird.name: MAG-7 | Seabird
mag-7-seabird.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in an aqua and tan color scheme.

Mine.

mp7-anodized-navy.name: MP7 | Anodized Navy
mp7-anodized-navy.desc: Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent navy blue anodized effect paint.

mp7-amberline.name: MP7 | Amberline
mp7-amberline.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been spray painted with diagonal orange and white bands.

A brand in-hand

mp9-ruby-poison-dart.name: MP9 | Ruby Poison Dart
mp9-ruby-poison-dart.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been painted with red and purple metallic paints over a black base coat.

Who says diamonds are a girl's best friend?

mp9-wild-lily.name: MP9 | Wild Lily
mp9-wild-lily.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. A custom paint job of a blue lily has been hand painted over a purple base.

Stop and smell the cordite

negev-desert-strike.name: Negev | Desert-Strike
negev-desert-strike.desc: The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. It has been custom painted with a high-tech design in tan and black.

nova-morning-sun.name: Nova | Morning Sun
nova-morning-sun.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. An intricate design has been applied using sand-colored paint.

Strength begins with light

p250-plum-netting.name: P250 | Plum Netting
p250-plum-netting.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been spray-painted with a purple and black lace pattern.

Don't call it a doily

r8-revolver-junk-yard.name: R8 Revolver | Junk Yard
r8-revolver-junk-yard.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. Its blue base has been covered in silver handwriting and drawings. The cylinder and front sight have been painted red.

Fit for a king

r8-revolver-tango.name: R8 Revolver | Tango
r8-revolver-tango.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. It has been custom painted with a wooden grip and roses.

Will you accept?

sawed-off-first-class.name: Sawed-Off | First Class
sawed-off-first-class.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. Its stock has been wrapped in green leather.

Mimosa not included

sawed-off-yorick.name: Sawed-Off | Yorick
sawed-off-yorick.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been given a skull hydrographic and hand painted gold accents.

Rosencrantz and Guildenstern never had a chance...

scar-20-fragments.name: SCAR-20 | Fragments
scar-20-fragments.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. The gunmetal-colored custom paint job creates the illusion that the weapon's geometry has changed.

Fragment of your imagination

sg-553-phantom.name: SG 553 | Phantom
sg-553-phantom.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been hand painted with a blue and grey design and finished with orange accents.

A ScyTech procurement

sg-553-night-camo.name: SG 553 | Night Camo
sg-553-night-camo.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been painted using a blue camo pattern.

A classic look for a new generation

ssg-08-parallax.name: SSG 08 | Parallax
ssg-08-parallax.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. The colors in this custom paint job were applied in offset positions, leading to an eye-popping look.

Shoot twice, kill once

ssg-08-big-iron.name: SSG 08 | Big Iron
ssg-08-big-iron.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been custom painted with a yellow and orange hydrographic then slightly distressed.

A win with an asterisk is still a win - Rona Sabri, Rising Star

ssg-08-spring-twilly.name: SSG 08 | Spring Twilly
ssg-08-spring-twilly.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. A black and green hydrographic pattern of assorted designs has been applied.

Last chance; train's leaving the station

ssg-08-sand-dune.name: SSG 08 | Sand Dune
ssg-08-sand-dune.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a sand dune color scheme.

With Turner dead, we have a new priority: rescue Alex Kincaide - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

tec-9-nuclear-threat.name: Tec-9 | Nuclear Threat
tec-9-nuclear-threat.desc: An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been spray-painted with radiological warning hazard patterns.

ump-45-motorized.name: UMP-45 | Motorized
ump-45-motorized.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. This custom paint job resembles a combustion engine, repurposed to be used as a weapon.

"With routine maintenance this'll last at least 500,000 bullets!"

usp-s-printstream.name: USP-S | Printstream
usp-s-printstream.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been custom painted with a stark black and white design and finished with pearlescent highlights.

WHITE_1; BLACK_1; PEARLESCENT_1; SILENCED_1; PISTOL_1;

usp-s-night-ops.name: USP-S | Night Ops
usp-s-night-ops.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been painted using a VariCamo patterned hydrographic.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction

usp-s-sleeping-potion.name: USP-S | Sleeping Potion
usp-s-sleeping-potion.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. A purple camo pattern with a pearlescent finish has been applied.

A new brew!

xm1014-red-python.name: XM1014 | Red Python
xm1014-red-python.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been painted with a snakeskin patterned hydrographic.

I know you don't believe in the cause...and when I expose you, Valeria will have your head - The Shield and The Serpent Part 1

bowie-knife.name: ★ Bowie Knife
bowie-knife.desc: This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations.
